title: Wings — Fixed Leading Edge Access Panel Fastener Pattern and Bonded Seal Installation

ata.title: Wing Leading Edge — Fixed Leading Edge Structure

abstract: Reduction of the access panel fastener pitch, installation of a bonded floating anchor nut strip and replacement of the sealant bead by a moulded seal at the fixed leading edge.

sections.planning_reason: Fixed leading edge access panels were being changed at a rate of about eleven per aircraft at the twelve-year check, almost all of them for elongated fastener holes at the forward edge. The panels are opened at every slat inspection, forty or more times in twelve years on a high-utilisation aircraft, and the anchor nut pattern was never designed for that. Water ingress at the same joint was also producing corrosion on the rib flange underneath at three operators in tropical service.
sections.description: The fastener pitch at the forward edge is reduced from ninety to sixty millimetres and the anchor nuts are replaced by floating items in a bonded strip, so that the load is shared rather than carried by two fasteners at each corner. The skin panel is re-drilled to the new pattern, brackets are added at the two inboard positions, a doubler is bonded under the forward edge and a moulded seal replaces the sealant bead at the panel land.
sections.accomplishment_summary: This Service Bulletin is accomplished at a heavy maintenance visit with both leading edges open. Do AMM-S-57-20-11-000-049-A to remove the access panels and record the as-found hole condition at every position. WARNING: DO NOT WORK UNDER AN UNSUPPORTED SLAT. Remove the existing anchor nuts and clean the faying surface. Drill the new sixty millimetre pitch using the jig supplied with the kit and de-burr every hole. Bond the doubler OR583107-28 under the forward edge and cure to the schedule in the accomplishment instructions. Install the bonded floating anchor nut strip. Install the bracket kit D5720111574269 at the two inboard positions. Re-drill the skin panel D5720113135325 to match. Remove the clip D5720119927541, which is not used at the new standard. Fit the moulded seal at the panel land and renew the edging grommet EN301916-66. Do AMM-S-57-20-11-400-049-A to install the panels and torque to the value given. Do a water ingress check by flooding the leading edge gutter and confirming a dry rib flange after ten minutes.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to SOLANO-38 and SOLANO-39 aircraft with Auran 7000 engines. Aircraft from MSN S01521 onward are post-modification from build. Both wings must be brought to the same standard in the same visit, because a post-modification panel will not fit a pre-modification wing and the panels are not marked left or right.
sections.material_note: Kit K5720-1032-01 covers one wing and contains the anchor nut strips, the doublers, the bracket kit, the moulded seals and the drill jig loan. Two kits are needed per aircraft. Lead time is twenty-six weeks. Removed panels are scrapped locally.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled heavy maintenance visit, or within 96 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.

consumables: Adhesive film, structural, 120 degrees C cure
